findings.issue: Hash verification and later ZIP-path import could observe different bytes.
findings.resolution: Sealed anonymous source snapshot is shared by member verification, zipimport, and original staging.

findings.issue: Lexical output containment could accept a parent-directory alias into WORK.
findings.resolution: Symlink rejection followed by path resolution before containment tests.

findings.issue: Trusting the assignment baseline key set allowed shortened or invented baselines.
findings.resolution: Unchanged original _base_paths on original-only staged WORK supplies the exact manifest-bound baseline map and frozen inventory; every frozen hash must match.

scope: Read-only core inspection; no edits or execution. Focused self-tests and real-packet results are separate receipts.
limits: The adapter does not independently authenticate assignment history or randomness.
The frozen materialization inventory relies on trustworthy provenance and completeness at recording time.
An otherwise quiescent WORK directory is required.
Static packaging validation is separate from runtime replay and training admission.
